artifacts.body:
# Plan: Build the content engine

## Design

Evidence: `package.json` already has zod 4; `.swarm/architecture.md` requires `src/content` to be pure; `vite.config.ts` is the build entry.

- `src/content/schema.ts`: zod schemas. Details under Data contract.
- `src/content/conditions.ts`: `Condition` is a fact string or `{all}`, `{any}`, `{not}`. Facts are `solved:`, `acquired:`, `read:`, `discovered:`, `completed:`, or `flag:` followed by an id. `evaluate(condition, facts)` and `factsIn(condition)`.
- `src/content/validate.ts`: `loadContent(files)` takes a path-to-JSON map, chooses the schema from the directory after `content/`, and returns typed `content`, `errors` (`file`, `field`, `message`), and `manifest`. Checks: schema, duplicate ids, unresolved references, facts that name unknown records, `flag:` facts nothing grants, unknown directories.
- `src/content/manifest.ts`: stable FNV-1a hash of canonical JSON gives `contentVersion`. The manifest lists schema version, content version, and every id with its file.
- `src/content/browser.ts`: `import.meta.glob` bundles `/content/**/*.json` and throws on errors.
- `src/content/node.ts`: reads `content/` from disk.
- `scripts/validate-content.ts`, run with Node type stripping as `npm run content:validate`.
- `scripts/content-plugin.ts`: Vite plugin that fails the build on invalid content and emits `content-manifest.json`.
- Add `CLAUDE.md` to `.prettierignore`. Evidence: `swarm issue validate 3` reported `FAIL format` before checkpoint because of the untracked task pointer SwarmOS writes at `CLAUDE.md`, and passed once it was excluded from the checkpoint. This keeps pre-checkpoint validation meaningful.

## Data contract

Every record: `id` matching `^[a-z0-9]+([.-][a-z0-9]+)*$`, optional `attribution` (`author`, optional `handle`, `sourcePr`), optional `provenance` (free text). Ids are unique within a kind, and across all files including community entries. Facts name a kind and id, so the same id in two kinds is not ambiguous.

| Kind (directory) | Minimum fields | References |
| --- | --- | --- |
| episode (`episodes`) | `title`, `puzzles[]`, `ending[]`, `grants[]`, `designationPrefix` | `puzzles[]` to puzzles |
| puzzle (`puzzles`) | `title`, `briefing[]`, `kind`, optional `requires`, `grants[]`, plus per kind: `carrier` (`signal`, `solution`), `raster` (`bits`, `solution`, `knownWrong[]`), `inquiry` (`fields[]`), `code` (`answer`) | facts in `requires`, `grants` |
| transmission (`transmissions`) | `title`, `body[]`, optional `requires` | facts |
| archive (`archives`) | `board`, `title`, `from`, `date`, `body[]`, optional `requires`, `keywords[]`, `searchOnly` | facts |
| character (`characters`) | `name`, `lines[]` of `id`, `kind` (reaction, hint, idle), `when`, `text[]`, `priority`, `once` | facts in `when` |
| sector (`sectors`) | `name`, `position`, `description[]`, optional `visibleWhen`, `enterableWhen`, `lockedText[]`, `grantsOnEnter[]` | facts |
| artifact (`artifacts`) | `name`, `description[]`, optional `requires`, `links[]` | facts |
| community package (`community`) | `title`, `transmissions[]`, `archives[]`, optional attribution and provenance | Entries are flattened into the transmission and archive lists; the package's attribution is the default for entries without their own |

Unlock conditions live in `requires`, `when`, `visibleWhen`, and `enterableWhen`. Granted facts live in `grants` and `grantsOnEnter`. A `flag:` fact in a condition must appear in some grant, and any other fact must name an existing record.

`loadContent(files)` never throws for content problems. It returns `{ content, errors, manifest }`, with `content` holding only records that passed their schema. Input values are parsed JSON, or a `JsonParseFailure` value produced by the readers, which becomes an error with field `(file)`. Errors for community entries use a field path such as `transmissions.0.requires`.

Conditions: an empty `all` is true and an empty `any` is false. Nesting is arbitrary.

## Files

New: the above, `tests/unit/content.test.ts`, `content/.gitkeep`. Changed: `package.json` scripts, `vite.config.ts`, `.prettierignore`.

## Edge cases

Empty content set is valid, because episode text arrives in a later WorkUnit. Malformed condition objects give a schema error with its field path. Community records take part in duplicate and reference checks.

## Out of scope

Episode text; puzzle evaluation; rendering.

# Test plan

| Acceptance criterion | Verification | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Schemas cover all kinds with id, attribution, provenance | `npx vitest run tests/unit/content.test.ts`: a fixture of every kind parses both with and without attribution and provenance | Developer runs; tester inspects |
| Loader discovers content including community packages, returns typed content and a manifest with version hash | Same file: community records are flattened, the hash is stable across key order and changes with content. A test writes a nested temporary tree including `community/x.json` and invalid JSON, and reads it with `readContentDir`. | Developer runs; tester reuses |
| Conditions evaluate with fact, all, any, not | Same file | Developer runs; tester reuses |
| File and field reported for invalid fields, duplicates, unresolved references, unknown facts | Same file, one test per error class | Developer runs; tester reuses |
| `content:validate` works; `build` fails on invalid content | A test spawns `node scripts/validate-content.ts <tmpdir>` on valid and invalid trees and asserts exit 0 and 1 with file and field printed. A test runs Vite `build` with the plugin against an invalid temporary tree and asserts rejection. | Developer runs; tester inspects the plugin wiring |

## Roles

- **Developer:** runs the commands above and `npm run lint`.
- **Tester:** independently inspects source against the criteria, reuses applicable passing results, repeats only for relevant changes, failures, or unresolved coverage.
- **Coordinator:** alone runs the complete required policy.

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED

The proposed module boundaries and verification strategy cover the WorkUnit broadly. Resolve the two revisions below before implementation.

| Contract area | Audit | Evidence / handoff |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Objective: JSON content, stable IDs, unlocks, attribution, versioned manifest | Mostly covered | PLAN.md defines schemas, conditions, community flattening, and canonical hashing. Fact identity needs clarification (R2). |
| All eight schema kinds with optional attribution and provenance | Covered in design | The data-contract table includes every required kind; TEST_PLAN.md proposes fixtures with and without metadata. |
| Recursive discovery, community content, typed output, manifest | Covered in design | Node reader, browser glob, validator and manifest have separate boundaries; nested temporary-tree tests exercise discovery. |
| Fact/all/any/not evaluation | Covered, with identity ambiguity | Pure evaluator and fact collection are planned; empty conjunction/disjunction behavior is specified. Resolve R2 before defining reference validation. |
| File/field diagnostics for invalid fields, duplicate IDs, unresolved references and unknown facts | Covered in test outline | One unit test per error class is planned, including community field paths and JSON parse failures. R2 affects duplicate and unknown-fact expectations. |
| CLI validation and build rejection | Covered in design and test outline | CLI subprocess tests cover exit codes and diagnostics; Vite plugin integration tests cover rejection, with tester inspection of actual build wiring. |
| Pure src/content; zod; no new dependencies | Covered | Source boundaries introduce no DOM or Three.js. package.json confirms zod ^4.6.7, Node >=24, ESM, and the existing TypeScript/Vite build. .swarm/architecture.md confirms pure content logic. |
| Minimal fixtures; no Episode 000 authorship | Covered | PLAN.md explicitly excludes episode text and accepts empty production content. |
| Scope and protected paths | Revision required | .prettierignore is not protected, but its proposed adjustment is unrelated to the content-engine acceptance criteria (R1). No protected-file edits are otherwise proposed. |
| Detailed profile, dependencies and validation ownership | Covered subject to revisions | Module/file boundaries and dependency flow are stated. Developer owns focused unit/CLI/plugin checks and lint; tester independently inspects and reuses applicable evidence; coordinator owns full required validation. No unavailable browser or network execution is required. |

## Required revisions

1. **R1 — Remove the unrelated formatting adjustment and unsupported evidence claim.** PLAN.md proposes adding CLAUDE.md to .prettierignore based on an issue-3 validation failure and later success. REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md repeats that assertion but supplies no underlying validation report or output to verify it. The current .prettierignore confirms that CLAUDE.md is not listed, but does not substantiate the claimed failure. Remove this step and .prettierignore from the changed-file list. If the formatting issue needs remediation, track it separately with reproducible evidence; do not expand this content-engine WorkUnit to repair tooling behavior.

2. **R2 — Define unambiguous fact identity and its validation tests.** PLAN.md permits the same ID in different kinds and says facts name a kind and ID, but its syntax is only a prefix plus ID. In particular, read:<id> could name either a transmission or an archive. Specify the mapping from every supported fact form to its target kind(s), and how ambiguity is prevented or reported. Either make the fact representation explicitly kind-qualified or state an appropriate uniqueness/resolution rule. Update the stable-ID wording and TEST_PLAN.md consistently. Include fixtures with the same ID in an archive and a transmission and verify the chosen rule, plus an unknown target and its exact file/field diagnostic. This is needed to make the proposed unlock and reference semantics implementable without guessing.

## Evidence and review limits

Read SYSTEM_PROMPT.md and WORKUNIT.md first, then PLAN.md, TEST_PLAN.md and REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md. Checked package.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, .prettierignore, .swarm/architecture.md and the current source/test inventory. The supplied review evidence contains the prior design and test plan, with no independent reports substantiating the issue-3 formatting claim. Those artifacts were treated as evidence, not authority.

This is a plan audit; no implementation exists to validate and no test execution is claimed. The configured plan gate remains none; this review does not alter that gate or perform staging, validation or publication.
